title: Slipknot and Disturbed Christmas Light Show
contentHtml:
YouTube user “slayer bob” has come back for another year of his heavy metal themed holiday light show at his house. He has been known for the light shows he posted online as early back as 2012 with bands such as Slayer, Pantera, and Machine Head.
Holiday season 2015 brings much glee and joy from “slayer bob” with is light shows themed to ‘Psychosocial’ by Slipknot and ‘Stricken’ by Disturbed. You can watch both light shows below! We all enjoy what you do “slayer bob” continue it.
Cheers to the holiday season from the Metal Lifestyle family.
